screen_notes: Median rank 1 of 3 (ranks 1,1,1). Emotional stakes, easy before/after promise. Copy idea only, not evidence.
summary: People restoring old family photos want faces to stay recognisable instead of being replaced by AI-invented faces.

evidence.claim: 12 dated complaints across 3 apps (FixMyPics, RetroFix, Photo Scan Plus) about restoration changing or distorting faces
evidence.source: state/scout/2026-11-17-photo-video.json (pv-c1; each quote has an Apple review RSS URL and date)

verifier.distinguishable_in_one_minute: Borderline (web competitors unsourced, free chat-AI substitutes; demand test decides)
verifier.capability_not_look: Yes (face regions composited from original, structural)
verifier.stack_fit: Borderline (restoration vendor, price and resolution unconfirmed; no account)

scores.risk_note: depends on model quality; spec must show a capability (e.g. restoration that is verifiably faithful) not a look

history.note: kept: one capability complaint across 3 apps; marginal on model-quality dependence
